detail.longDescription: The same few files every morning, each in a different folder? Mark them as favorites in Nitilo: a yellow star takes the place of the icon, and they gather in one list, folders first, each file showing where it lives. Put them in the order you work: drag, or Move up from the keyboard. A file dropped from your desktop joins already marked, and the order holds after a reload. https:// youtu.be/3PIuvNwLBUE # Productivity # FileManagement
